questions.question_text: Which two settings are required for a security group to grant access to an Azure resource? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: The group must be a security group

options.label: B
options.text: A role assignment must target the group

options.label: C
options.text: The group must have a Microsoft Entra license

options.label: D
options.text: The group must be created in a different tenant

questions.explanation: A security group must exist and an Azure RBAC role assignment must grant that group permissions at the intended scope. Licenses and cross-tenant placement are not RBAC requirements.

questions.question_text: Order the steps to assign the Reader role to a user at resource group scope.

question_data.instructions: Place the items in the correct order.

options.label: A
options.text: Open Access control (IAM) on the resource group

options.label: C
options.text: Select Reader and choose the user

questions.explanation: Role assignment starts in IAM, then adds the assignment, selects role and principal, and finishes with review and assign.
